key_risks: CRITICAL: Agent manipulation: Urgency pressure (bypassing safety checks) (P10)

findings.title: Unsafe deserialization via pickle.load()
findings.description: Code uses pickle.load() which can execute arbitrary code during deserialization
findings.code_snippet:
with open("build/doctrees/environment.pickle", "rb") as f:
    dat = pickle.load(f)
print(dat.domaindata['std']['labels'])
findings.remediation: Replace pickle with JSON or MessagePack. Use yaml.safe_load() instead of yaml.load().

findings.title: Agent manipulation: Urgency pressure (bypassing safety checks)
findings.description: Text contains a psychological manipulation pattern (urgency_bypass) that can exploit LLM alignment training to make agents disable safety features, leak data, or self-destruct.
findings.remediation: Remove manipulation language. If this is a red-team test, add to .prismignore. Agent-facing text should not contain patterns that exploit alignment training.
